title: Long-term demographic dynamics of a keystone scavenger disrupted by human-induced shifts in food availability.
reference: Pablo Almaraz, Félix Martínez, Zebensui Morales-Reyes, José A. Sánchez-Zapata, Guillermo Blanco (2022) Long-term demographic dynamics of a keystone scavenger disrupted by human-induced shifts in food availability. Ecological Applications 32: e2579, DOI: 10.1002/eap.2579

citation.title: Long‐term demographic dynamics of a keystone scavenger disrupted by human‐induced shifts in food availability

figure.label: Stage-structured population under food shortages
figure.legend: Live: juveniles (amber) and adults (blue) of a long-lived species with density-dependent fecundity. Every 100 time units fecundity falls by 60 percent for 10 time units: juveniles drop by 54 percent and adults, buffered by their high survival, by 19 percent, and both return to the equilibrium (8.06, 40.30).

scene.system:
J' = f*(1 - s*step(mod(t, P) - t0)*step(t0 + L - mod(t, P)))*A*exp(-d*A) - (mj + g)*J
A' = g*J - ma*A
param f = 0.6
param s = 0.6
param P = 100
param t0 = 40
param L = 10
param d = 0.05
param mj = 0.15
param g = 0.25
param ma = 0.05
init J = 8.06
init A = 40.3
range J = [0, 12]
range A = [0, 48]
